tests.goal: Confirm that a new project can be created

acceptanceCriteria: The project is created and listed

tests.goal: Confirm that a chat can be started inside a project

steps.action: Start a new chat from within it.
acceptanceCriteria: The chat is scoped to the project

tests.goal: Confirm that a chat can be moved to a different project

steps.action: Open a chat in a project.
Click the three dots and pick a different project.
acceptanceCriteria: The chat moves to the other project

tests.goal: Confirm that a chat can be taken out of a project

steps.action: Click "Remove from project" on the project chip.
acceptanceCriteria: The chat is no longer in the project

tests.goal: Confirm that a project can be deleted without losing its chats

steps.action: Delete a project that has scoped chats.

tests.goal: Confirm that a project can be renamed

steps.action: Select the options of a project.
Select "Rename" and enter a new name.
acceptanceCriteria: The project shows the new name
